brief:
Captured video shows Israeli forces deploying drones to plant explosives inside homes in the southern Lebanese town of Mansouri, according to Eye on Palestine. The operation involves detonating the structures as part of a broader campaign targeting entire neighborhoods in the region. Residents have documented the systematic demolitions across multiple residential areas.

The footage presents evidence of what observers describe as a policy of large-scale erasure in southern Lebanon. The drone-based demolition method allows forces to destroy buildings without ground troops entering homes, enabling rapid destruction of multiple properties across populated areas simultaneously.
